title: RepublishEprEvent
description: Payload shape for an EconomicEvent with action='republish-epr'. Emitted on every substrate-correct deploy of an EPR bundle. The event back-references its bounding delegates-compute Commitment via bounded_by. Source of truth: Holochain DHT (EPR substrate via FederatedEprStore + Kad StartProviding; projected to elohim-storage 'economic_events' SQLite table). Canon: genesis/docs/architecture/rea-compute-commitment-primitive.md. Spec: genesis/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-25-stagespablob-substrate-correct-deploy.md §2.

performer.description: CID or agent identifier of the agent emitting this event. For Z.D this is the deploy-svc-agent.

bounded_by.description: CID of the delegates-compute Commitment authorizing this event. The substrate's bounds validator walks this back-reference to verify standing, scope, reach ceiling, and rate limit. ALWAYS required — anonymous publish has no place in this substrate (canon §6 rule 2).

target.description: CID of the new EprHead being published.

supersedes.description: CID of the previous EprHead being superseded, or null for first-publish of a new EPR. First-publish still requires bounded_by — anonymous publish is forbidden.

blob_cid.description: CID of the new blob bytes (sha256 multihash + dag-cbor codec 0x71 per elohim/epr/src/cid.rs convention).

epr_kind.description: The EprKind enum value for the new EprHead. For bundle deploys this is 'Content'.

reach.description: Reach value declared by the new EprHead's envelope. Substrate validator checks this against the bounding Commitment's reach_ceiling.

bundle_path.description: Optional human-readable bundle identifier (e.g. 'lamad-spa'). For audit clarity only; substrate logic uses target CID.

signed_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the event was signed. Used for rate-limit sliding-window calculations.
